findings.title: The October comparison lines under the headline figures are small and pale

location.description: The small line under each of the four headline figures in the top row

findings.viewer_experience: The comparison with last month is what makes each figure meaningful, yet it is set in the smallest, palest text on the screen and gives no sign of direction.

current.value: The comparison line is small pale grey text with the old figure only.

findings.target: The comparison reads at a glance as better or worse than last month.
findings.fix_direction: Make the comparison easier to read and show the direction of change.

closed_when.check: Look at the top row: each headline figure has a comparison that is easy to read and shows the direction of change.

findings.title: The weekday bar chart shows a value for only one bar

location.description: The Tickets by weekday chart in the right card of the middle row

findings.viewer_experience: One bar carries the number 148 and the other six have no value and there is no value axis, so only the highest bar can be read as a number.

current.value: One bar is labelled and six bars have no value.

findings.target: Every bar can be read as a number.
findings.fix_direction: Add a value axis or a number on every bar.
findings.source: Tufte, The Visual Display of Quantitative Information

closed_when.check: Look at the bar chart: every bar can be read as a number.
